blog_queue.title: How to Turn monday.com Data Into Client-Ready Reports Without Touching Word or Excel
blog_queue.brief: Most monday.com users waste 45+ minutes reformatting board data into polished client reports every week. This post shows a faster path that keeps everything inside monday.
blog_queue.description: Target keyword: "generate client reports from monday.com." H2 sections: (1) Why exporting to Word/Excel breaks your workflow, (2) What data already lives in your monday.com items that clients actually want to see, (3) The anatomy of a good client report — status, metrics, next steps, (4) How to map monday.com columns to report sections automatically, (5) Sending the report directly from monday.com without leaving the tool, (6) How DocuAI pulls item data and populates a client-ready report in one click. Closes with a CTA to try DocuAI on their next weekly reporting cycle.
